typography.instructions: Import 'Public Sans' and 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts. Use Public Sans for all Headings (h1-h3) to give a 'Utility/Government' clean feel. Use Inter for body text. Use JetBrains Mono for tags, IDs, and code snippets.

layout.spacing_system: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for containers. Use gap-4 for lists.
layout.grid_strategy: List-First. The main view is a vertical stack (flex-col) or a Table. Do not use Masonry grids for this project logger.

ProjectRow.description: A horizontal strip representing a project. Not a card.
ProjectRow.style: border-b border-border hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors p-4 flex items-center justify-between group
ProjectRow.interactions: Clicking the row opens details. Action buttons (Edit, Build) appear on hover (opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100).

BuildButton.description: The primary action to 'build' a project.
BuildButton.style: border border-dashed border-blue-500/40 text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:border-solid hover:border-blue-600 transition-all rounded-sm px-3 py-1 text-xs font-mono uppercase

StatusBadge.style: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium ring-1 ring-inset ring-gray-500/10

SearchInput.style: w-full bg-muted/30 border-none focus:ring-0 text-lg placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50 py-4

visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React. Use thin strokes (stroke-width={1.5}) for a refined look.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the background (opacity 0.02) to give a paper feel.

empty_states.description: Use these abstract geometric images for 'No Projects Found' or 'Welcome' screens.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Stick to solid, matte colors.
Use 'Inter' for UI text but 'Public Sans' for Headings to differentiate from default Shadcn.
Ensure Dark Mode is not 'Pitch Black' (#000000) but 'Dark Grey' (#191919).
All interactive elements must have a data-testid attribute.
Avoid 'Card' components for the main list. Use a 'Table' or 'List Row' metaphor.
The 'Build' button should feel mechanical/technical, not like a marketing CTA.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a Notion-style Project Logger. Focus on the 'List View' as the primary interface. The 'Add Project' experience should be a modal or a slide-over, not a separate page. Use the provided image URLs for empty states. Implement the 'Build' button with the specific dashed-border style defined in components.
